confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief. Radio at 09:30 says scoop 2 is stopped at N522-15, but CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago as operational. Confirm whether LH-02 is running. I moved nothing for this place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-N600-09 (OT-5100, hydraulic, repaired on site, 3-5 h, likely 4 h). Radio and CMMS agree on this, so covering it is allowed. N600-09 is the best stope: 11.9 g/t, about 239 t still to muck. LH-08 comes from DS-C538-01, a cheap infrastructure heading at 0.2 oz/h, so it is the cheapest loader to take. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. LH-07 would leave a producing Central stope, so I left it. Travel for LH-08 is about 0.65 h: ramp, 6 km on the surface, ramp, drift, plus the 0.25 h manoeuvre. At 220 m, an LH410 mucks 30x100/118 = 25.4 t/h. Over about 6.85 h that is about 174 t, or 174x11.9/31.1 = about 66 oz. Norte's stockpile is 242 of 450 t. The extra loader adds about 160 t, so it ends near 400 t and does not fill. Development cost is 0.2x7.5 = about 1.5 oz. Net is about 60 oz after allowing for truck limits and repair-time uncertainty. N522-15 is not covered because of the radio/CMMS conflict (CONFIRM-01). No reserves are activated, because no stope is stopped. If LH-01 is repaired, the layer decides whether the loan goes home (RETURN-01).
